definitions.explanation: An official document showing a student's grades or academic performance.

examples.japanese: {成績表|せいせきひょう}をもらった。
{成績表|せいせきひょう}を{親|おや}に{見|み}せなければならない。
examples.english: I have to show my report card to my parents.

examples.japanese: {就職活動|しゅうしょくかつどう}には{大学|だいがく}の{成績表|せいせきひょう}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: A university transcript is needed for job hunting.

notes:
{成績表|せいせきひょう} shows a student's academic performance. At primary/secondary schools, it's typically given at the end of each term. At universities, it lists all course grades.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {成績表|せいせきひょう}をもらう (to receive a report card)
- {成績表|せいせきひょう}を{発行|はっこう}する (to issue a transcript)
- {成績表|せいせきひょう}の{写|うつ}し (copy of transcript)

RELATED TERMS:
- {成績|せいせき} (grades, performance)
- {通知表|つうちひょう} (report card - elementary/middle school)
- {単位|たんい} (academic credit)
